senses.gloss: Nāsatya, name of one of the two Aśvins. § 15 (Upamanyu): I, 3, ††723 (º-Dasrau).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 89, †4594 (º--Dasrātrisutodbhavādyaiḥ, among the surgeons of Indra, only in C.).--§ 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7583 (Nºś caiva Dasraś ca smṛtau dvāv Aśvināv api).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 340, 12917 (ºañ caiva Dasrañ ca bhishajau). --§ 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7095 (ºś cāpi Dasraś ca smṛtau deva Aśvināv api).

Nāsatya, adj. (“relating to the Aśvins,”. viz. one of Brahmán's births). § 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 348, 13491 (ºañ ca…janma, the fifth birth of Brahmán, Aśvidaivatyaghrāṇajaṃ, Nīl.); 349, V), 13585 (ºe janmani …Brahmaṇaḥ).
